newsitem.title: CANADA: Sherritt raises debenture issue to C$675 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sherritt raises debenture issue to C$675 mln.

text.p: Sherritt International Corp said on Tuesday it has increased the size of its offering of convertible unsecured subordinated debentures to C$675 million from C$600 million.
The increase was made "in response to market demand," the nickel company said in a statement.

On Monday, Sherritt announced a bought deal of C$300 million in 6.0 percent, 10-year convertible debentures with an over-allotment provision of C$300 million. Sherritt increased the over-allotment by C$75 million on Tuesday. It plans to use the proceeds to expand its investments in Cuba.
